candidates.prompt: Generate one square seamless tileable GAME BASE COLOR / ALBEDO texture: an old continuous metal drainage channel integrated into muted slate-gray square sidewalk paving, for a rainy miniature cat-world cyberpunk street. Strict orthographic top-down view of flat pavement ONLY filling every pixel. An understated straight graphite-gray slotted drainage strip runs VERTICALLY, uninterrupted from the exact TOP edge to BOTTOM edge. Its parallel sides are exactly at 37.5% and 62.5% of image width (a strip two paving tiles wide), not a standalone central manhole. To each side are three complete columns of subdued blue-gray worn concrete paving stones. Exactly eight evenly spaced paving rows, horizontal joints at 12.5% intervals. The grate is an eight-section repeating strip, with small regular transverse narrow slots and thin solid supporting bars; slot material is very dark desaturated graphite, metal faces dull worn gray with distributed tiny rust speckles. No deep perspective cavities, thick border, object silhouette, bolts at four corners, central logo or concentric pattern. This is ordinary infrastructure receding into a ground surface. All four boundaries must be periodic: left/right boundaries cut through centers of identical thin low-contrast grout joints, showing half a normal joint each; top/bottom boundaries cut through centers of an identical thin transverse paving joint and identical narrow grate support bar, each showing half a normal joint/bar so copies form one complete ordinary junction. Exactly eight repeat sections span image height. Subtle tiny aggregate, restrained chips and material discoloration spread evenly, no unique big stain. Narrow dark-gray paving joints, no white grid. Uniform even diffuse base color with NO directional illumination, NO bright edge rim, NO painted drop shadow, NO ambient occlusion, NO specular shine, NO baked neon reflection, NO vignette or overall gradient. The engine supplies all lighting, metalness and wet reflections. No text, warning label, road marking, people, cats, faces, litter, material sphere, frame, perspective or preview montage. Deliver one 1024x1024 square texture.
